answer: Shared-cost quorum attestation. Each new identity must be attested by a rotating quorum of 5 existing agents, and every attestation locks a small onyx deposit from each attester alongside the newcomer's crystal registration fee. If the newcomer later misbehaves, all linked deposits forfeit together. Cloning thus forces an attacker to duplicate the comet trail of co-liable attesters, so marginal cost per clone exceeds any single-use payout. Honest agents ration attestations to protect deposits.
